description: Class representing an animation sequence (main sequence or interactive sequence).

AddEffect.description: Adds an animation effect to the sequence.

returns.description: The created animation effect, or null if creation failed.

AddEffect.signature: AddEffect(drawing: ApiDrawing, effectType: AnimationEffectType, trigger?: AnimationTriggerType): ApiAnimationEffect | null

GetClassType.description: Returns the type of the ApiAnimationSequence class.

GetCount.description: Returns the number of effects in the sequence.

GetEffect.description: Returns the effect at the specified index.

params.description: The zero-based index of the effect.
params.name: index

returns.description: The effect at the specified index, or null if not found.

RemoveAllEffects.description: Removes all effects from the sequence.

returns.description: True if effects were removed successfully.
